cleanCompletion: Valid foot-only board takeoff and stand clearance, no rotated recontact, declared upright-referenced somersault phase and airborne twist, central posture with actual tuck hand proximity, bilateral form, nearby hand-first entry; execution at least 6/10. Zero invalid-launch episodes may count clean. V6 additionally requires both physical foot-line errors <20 degrees, both hand-axis errors <30 degrees, hand-tip separation <0.12 m and vertical mismatch <0.04 m. V7 additionally requires knee/ankle/toe center gaps below 0.19/0.16/0.15 m without crossing. Report actual whole-diver COM ascent from final departure; preparation hops cannot count as ascent. V8 additionally requires completion by0.8s after first contact: every physical athlete collider must be fully immersed inside the basin. Body-angle, bilateral form and physical foot/hand/leg gates apply across that whole interval, not only the hands-contact snapshot. The underwater arc after full submersion is excluded.
eligibilitySelection: Choose conservative minimum heights from development validation, then report the separately seeded final tests. Unsupported lower heights are disabled, with their measured failures retained in the report.
stress: Report 11 m and ±120 N pushes beyond training support; these cases do not set normal eligibility or enter its averages.
feedbackAblation: Paired fresh feedback versus replay of nominal commands under a scheduled0.12s physical torso push. Record actual applied duration/impulse because airborne overlap can truncate the window. Independently recompute native and WASM policy actions throughout flight and complete entry; report both performance distributions and all discrepancies.
reportFailures: Every failed episode remains in completion, execution distributions and score means. No showcase or successful-only subset is used for benchmark means.
launchClearance: Report per-skill launch-clear rate, nonfoot board and stand force peaks, foot side/underside contact, rotated recontacts and the final stable takeoff reference. Native and WASM measure physical contacts every 2 ms.
somersaultClassification: Principal signed takeoff pitch relative to upright (bounded ±60°) plus unwrapped airborne swing. No accumulated preparation turns are credited. Axial twist counts only after final departure. These are explicit simulator approximations of the declared numeric dive.
